family.description: Soyuz is a series of spacecraft which has been in service since the 1960s, having made more than 140 flights. It was designed for the Soviet space program by the Korolev Design Bureau (now Energia).

landing.description: The Soyuz spacecraft safely landed in Kazakhstan.

spacecraft.description: Soyuz TM-32 was a Soyuz spacecraft which launched on 28 April 2001 07:37 UTC. It transported two astronauts and one spaceflight participant to the International Space Station.
